fix(table): a NaN column bound is no bound (rich-table-hge) (#202)

* fix(table): a NaN column bound is no bound, parsed where it enters the column (rich-table-hge)

A minWidth or maxWidth of NaN reached Math.max/Math.min in _naturalWidth,
poisoned the natural width, and erased the whole column. The bounds are now
accessors that hold NaN as undefined, so the guarantee holds for a bound
assigned after construction too. Infinity stays a real bound. The existing
'treats NaN column bounds as no bounds' test asserted the collapsed frame;
it now asserts the content-sized one its name promises.

* fix(table): read column and table bounds as cell counts, one rule for every width (rich-table-hge)
